localities.name: City and County of San Francisco
localities.covers: Work performed in San Francisco — at least two hours in a week. San Francisco is a single consolidated city and county, so there is no separate unincorporated rate.

facts.summary: San Francisco sets its own minimum wage of $19.61 an hour from 1 July 2026, well above the California floor. It covers anyone who works at least two hours in a week in the city, including temporary and part-time staff.
facts.citation: San Francisco Minimum Wage Ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 12R)
facts.sourceAgency: San Francisco Office of Labor Standards Enforcement
